title: flex-screen profile
description: A flex-screen profile (%LOCALAPPDATA%\flex-screen\profiles\<name>.json, or the synced profiles folder). Everything is optional; the companion re-reads the file when it's saved. This PC's own settings (the profile in use, the profiles folder, the Obsidian vault's folder) are in machine.json, which can also set any of these to override the profile on this PC.

idle.description: Idle minutes before the deck shows its clock, and before its screen goes off. 0 turns either off.

cheatSheetSeconds.description: How long a layer key is held before the deck shows the cheat sheet; 0: only from the pill.

approveFromDeck.description: Claude's permission requests wait for Approve or Deny on the deck.

accounts.description: The accounts this profile uses, by id (lower-case letters, digits and "-"): Google accounts, Microsoft 365 or Outlook.com calendars, and calendar links. Without it, one Google account: "google". Each PC signs in to each account once (tray: Google accounts, Calendars); the sign-ins, and a calendar link's address, stay on the PC.

hiddenTaskLists.description: Task lists left off the deck's Tasks card, as "source/list id" (the tray's Task lists on the deck). Their dated tasks still show under Scheduled.

obsidianTasks.description: The latest Obsidian daily note's "- [ ]" tasks on the deck.

microsoftTodo.description: Microsoft To Do, with your own app registration (tray: Task sources, Microsoft To Do).

tenant.description: common; consumers for personal accounts only; or your organization's.

jira.description: Jira issues assigned to you (tray: Task sources, Jira). The token is kept on each PC, per site.

email.description: Jira Cloud only: your Atlassian email.

jql.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

name.description: The list's name on the deck.

github.description: GitHub issues assigned to you (tray: Task sources, GitHub). The token is kept on each PC, per host.

host.description: github.com, or your GitHub Enterprise server.

name.description: The list's name on the deck.

shortcuts.description: The launcher's tiles, up to 12 (tray: Shortcuts…).

contextBar.description: Your own keys for the context bar, per app: by exe name ("chrome") or the name the deck shows ("Chrome"); "*" for apps without keys of their own. false turns the bar off.

calendarFilter.description: Events kept off the deck, from every calendar (tray: Calendars).

hideTitles.description: A word or phrase in the title (any case), or a /regular expression/.

hideFree.description: Those marked free (Google's Available, Outlook's Free or Working elsewhere).

sites.description: Your own sites with keys on the context bar in a browser; one with a built-in site's id replaces it (gmail, youtube, calendar, jira, github).

id.description: The bar's key is "chrome:<id>": the deck keeps your arrangement by it.

name.description: The bar's name on the deck.

url.description: Addresses without https://, host and path, * for anything: "www.notion.so/*". Needs the browser extension.

app.description: Installed web apps, by their name in the Start menu.

default.description: The ids of the keys on the bar until it's arranged on the deck.

pages.description: Which pages the deck shows, in tab order; without it the six as they've always been, and Panels when there are panels. The deck restarts into another order.

panels.description: Lists of your own on the deck's Panels page, up to 4: read from a web address (JSON, or text with a row per line). A "command" instead runs on the PC, so it's only taken from this PC's machine.json, never from a profile.

glyph.description: An icon of the deck's font: branch, download, pen, bolt, play…

url.description: http or https: a list of rows, or {"rows": [...], "note": "…"}; a row is text or {"text", "sub", "badge", "open"}.

command.description: machine.json only: run through cmd from your user folder (30 s at most); its output read as for url.

app.description: A Start menu app, by its name there; brought to the front if it's open.

keys.description: Keys pressed in the window in front: "Win+Shift+S".

glyph.description: The symbol shown without an icon: mail, calendar, note, terminal, code, music, media, volume, lock, desktop, folder, keys, git, call.

icon.description: A picture file, or a program whose icon to use.

keys.description: Pressed in the app's window; "g, i" presses one after the other.

glyph.description: An icon of the deck's icon font: search, split-right, back, play… (firmware/scripts/gen_font_icons.py).

id.description: Kept with the arrangement on the deck; else made from the name.

type.description: Taken from the id's start when left out ("google-work", "microsoft-work", "ics-school").

label.description: Its name on the deck and in the tray: "Work" makes "Google Tasks (Work)", "Outlook (Work)".

client.description: Google: its own OAuth client file, in %LOCALAPPDATA% lex-screen (or a full path). Without it, google-client.json, which every account can share.

calendar.description: Google: its events on the deck's calendar.

tasks.description: Google: its task lists on the deck's Tasks card.

clientId.description: Microsoft: the app registration's Application (client) ID; without it, microsoftTodo's.

tenant.description: Microsoft: common; organizations for work accounts only; or your organization's.

url.description: Calendar link: a public calendar's address. A private one (it works as a password) is kept on each PC instead.

calendars.description: Which of its calendars go on the deck, by name or id, over the source's own choice (ticked in Google Calendar; Outlook's main one).
